name: Siigo MCP Server
description: Enables interaction with the Siigo API to manage products, customers, and invoices with enterprise-grade security features like RBAC and audit logging. It supports financial reporting operations and secure data handling through the Model Context Protocol.

rawRecord.description: Enables interaction with the Siigo API to manage products, customers, and invoices with enterprise-grade security features like RBAC and audit logging. It supports financial reporting operations and secure data handling through the Model Context Protocol.

NODE_ENV.description: The execution environment, usually set to 'production'.

SIIGO_ROLE.description: The security role for the server: 'viewer' (read-only), 'editor' (read + create/update), or 'admin' (full access).

SIIGO_BASE_URL.description: Base URL for the Siigo API (e.g., https://sandbox.siigo.com for testing).

SIIGO_USERNAME.description: Email address of the Siigo account with API access.

ENABLE_AUDIT_LOG.description: Whether to enable audit logging for all operations.

SIIGO_ACCESS_KEY.description: The API access key provided by Siigo.

MASK_SENSITIVE_DATA.description: Whether to mask sensitive data in the log files.

RATE_LIMIT_REQUESTS.description: Number of allowed requests per tool within the rate limit window.

RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW_MS.description: The duration of the rate limit window in milliseconds.
